description: This file defines a middleware factory function for request validation in an Express.js application using Joi schemas. It creates middleware that validates and sanitizes request data based on provided schemas and handles validation errors.

methods.name: validate(schema, property = 'body')
methods.description: Factory function that creates Express middleware to validate specific request properties ('body', 'query', 'params') using Joi schemas, and handles validation errors by passing ValidationError with details.
